working_definition: Author type 'Dm3b' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Dm3 neuron with posterior-dorsally oriented dendrites (Ozel et al., 2021). It can be distinguished from Dm3a based on its expression of bi (Ozel et al., 2021).
